records.subject: Getting started with Wrenfield
records.body:
Hi Maya,

Thanks for trying Wrenfield. A quick tip: projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them -- so the first few minutes are usually spent creating one project and adding a few tasks to it.

Let us know how it goes.

Best,
Nadia Goldberg

draft.subject: A hand with your first Wrenfield project
draft.body:
Hi Maya,

Following up on our welcome call last week — I know the first week gets busy. Whenever you're ready, projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them, so creating one project and adding a few tasks is usually the quickest way in. The in-app onboarding flow walks through creating a first project.

If it's easier, I'd be glad to walk through that first project with you on a short call this week — just tell me a day that works and I'll send an invite.

Best,
Nadia
